claim: The source-checkout runtime reports service version 0.2.0 on /health and /context even though the checked-in package version is 0.2.1.
trigger: Run the ASGI app from this checkout while the tracked kbc_artifact_hub.egg-info metadata is available to importlib.metadata.
impact: Health, context, landing-page, and OpenAPI version metadata identify the running service as the prior release, so clients and operators cannot reliably correlate the advertised version with the checked-in release.

evidence.detail: pyproject.toml:3 declares version = 0.2.1, while tracked kbc_artifact_hub.egg-info/PKG-INFO:3 declares Version: 0.2.0.
README.md:7-11 says /health and /context report the running version and describes installed metadata as derived from pyproject.toml.

runtime.command: timeout 30 env -i PATH=/Users/padak/github/kbc_ai_artifact/.venv/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 TMPDIR=/Users/padak/github/kbc_ai_artifact/_review/runtime/smoke-tmp HUB_STORAGE_TOKEN=smoke-storage-token HUB_STACK_URL=https://smoke.invalid HUB_SECRET_KEY=smoke-secret-key HUB_CACHE_DIR=/Users/padak/github/kbc_ai_artifact/_review/runtime/smoke-tmp/cache /Users/padak/github/kbc_ai_artifact/.venv/bin/python3 _review/runtime/smoke-tmp/smoke.py
runtime.environment: Sanitized env via env -i; only PATH, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, PYTHONHASHSEED, TMPDIR, and dummy HUB_* values; no external network; TestClient with InMemoryFilesBackend; cache under _review/runtime/smoke-tmp.
runtime.output_excerpt: Contained TestClient checks all returned expected statuses; /health JSON included {artifacts: 0, hydrated: true, status: ok, version: 0.2.0}; /context returned service kbc-artifact-hub and 23 endpoints.
runtime.expected: The runtime version should match the checked-in release declaration 0.2.1 (or generated package metadata must be regenerated consistently before launch).
runtime.proves: The app is executable in a local in-memory lifespan, but its public version fields resolve to stale installed metadata rather than the current pyproject release declaration.

suggested_fix: Regenerate/remove tracked egg-info as part of the release/build workflow, or validate that installed metadata matches pyproject before serving the version.
